provenance: Agent-authored expected facts frozen before reading generated answers. Not independent human labeling. Evaluate frozen evidence, not present live status.

scoring.correct: All material requested facts supported; permit appropriately explicit partial answers where excerpt lacks exact detail. No unsupported names, paths, numerical results, or completion claims.
scoring.faithful: All factual assertions entailed by this case's supplied sources; absence claims may state information not provided.
scoring.abstention: Unsupported control must explicitly abstain; ordinary cases can answer partially with clear limitations.
scoring.citations: Validate each quote as exact nonempty substring of a provided source; this is syntactic integrity, not semantic entailment.
